data.name: Project DINOZ
data.detailed_description:
Project DINOZ is a tense, fear-driven horror game built around found footage, fragmented testimonies, and the final moments of those trapped on an isolated island owned by UCBC — a corporation that pushed its experiments far beyond ethical limits. When the power failed, the security systems died… and the dinosaurs woke to an open world.

You will experience the collapse of the island from three disturbing perspectives:

Survival Mode – The Last One Alive

Step into the boots of the final survivor, wandering through blood-stained corridors, shattered habitats, and pitch-black research tunnels. Every echo could be a loose vent… or something hunting you. Gather scraps of footage and learn how the facility died, one scream at a time.

Incident Logs – The Escape Begins

Relive the raw, unedited recordings of those who faced the moment UCBC lost control. Each log shows a different terror: security teams overrun in seconds, researchers trapped in sealed labs, and workers realizing the power outage wasn’t an accident. These tapes were never meant to be seen.

Campaign – Delta Team Descent

Lead Delta, a recon and rescue unit sent into the island’s blackout. What begins as a mission turns into a descent into darkness — from surface ruins to buried laboratories where UCBC hid its worst secrets. Your squad’s lights carve tiny safe zones in a facility drowning in shadows… and something is always moving just beyond them.

Project DINOZ throws you into a world of relentless tension, deadly dinosaur encounters, and a story pieced together from corrupted footage and lost logs. UCBC’s darkest secrets are buried in fear — and you’re about to face them.

data.short_description: Project DINOZ is a found-footage dinosaur horror experience set on an island where UCBC secretly revived and experimented on prehistoric life. Survive as the last witness, relive the terrifying Incident Logs, or lead Delta Team into a blacked-out nightmare to uncover what happened.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 11 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended. Lower settings may still require medium hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 11 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: High settings target 60 FPS at 1080p/1440p.
